relevance_note: In scope: the paper gives individual-level data for SSADHD patients, e.g. "Seventeen post‐newborn DBS included: 10 M/7F, ages 0.8‐38 years" and Table 1 lists each patient's ALDH5A1 mutations, age and sex.
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema and the rules. The Markdown uses a thin space (U+2009) between numbers and units (e.g. '843 mmol/mol', '0.8‐38 years') and around '<'; spans were copied with that character, escaped as \u2009. Tables 3 and 4 list metabolite values with no patient label column, so no value was assigned to a person by row position (D-31). Tables 1 and 2 both number patients 1-7; the Table 2 note "Patients 1 and 2 identical to patients 1 and 2 in Table 1" shows those are the same people, so the Table-2-only patients are labelled "Patient N (Table 2)" to keep labels unique; Tables 3/4 rows correspond to the same 10 newborn DBS (7 patients) and 17 post-newborn patients. Patients 5 (Table 1) and 4 (Table 2) have "NA" for both mutations and get no variants row. The "See above" allele notes of patients 10, 12, 16 and 17 (and "See above20" of patient 14) point to the note for the same variant in an earlier row; functional evidence was recorded with both spans. Contradiction found: rows 11 and 12 print "CH (parents untested)" while the Table 1 note lists "11 and 12" among sibships "all confirmed by sequencing of the parents"; the row text was used. Patient 10's Mutation 1 cell prints 'p.T233\u2009M' (thin space) and Mutation 2 'p.T233M'; recorded as p.T233M. The sibship note says parents were sequenced but never says which parent carries a variant, so inheritance is "not reported" everywhere. Gene symbol spans are study-level ("mutations of the ALDH5A1 gene"), because the gene is not printed beside each variant. Patient 8's variant is only 'See legend', so variant_original_string is "not reported". The adult male in the fifth decade mentioned with reference 5 is included as in scope (sex and age given) and labelled "ref [5] patient". GHB results are recorded as phenotypic features. No clinical feature is reported for any individual, so every checklist row is "not reported". Patient 14's "See above20" cites a publication for the allele note, not a prior report of the patient, and the paper never states that its patients were published earlier, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients = false; no span is given for false booleans.
